description: This file defines a React component named ErrorBoundary for catching JavaScript errors in the React component tree and rendering fallback UI, along with related functions and a default fallback component.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: A React component class that implements an error boundary to catch errors in its child components and display fallback UI.

methods.name: resetError
methods.description: Resets the error state, allowing the component to attempt rendering its children again after an error.
